name: generate_image
description: Generate an image from a text description using DALL-E and store it as a permanent asset. Returns a public URL that can be sent via message nodes.
author: system

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate. Be specific and vivid for better results.

style.description: Image style hint prepended to the prompt (e.g., 'pixel art', 'watercolor', 'photorealistic', 'dark fantasy illustration')

quality.description: Image quality (standard is faster and cheaper)

parameters.prompt: A crumbling stone tower at the edge of a misty forest, lit by a single torch
